book.name: Jon
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Jon Le Rorori

content: Jisas i yomara weŋgiya gharaghambu e Njighɨ Taibiriyas
Mbaŋa vamba gheviye eŋge e ghereiye, Jisas mbowo i yomara weŋgiva gharaghambu Njighɨ Taibiriyas e ghadidiye.
Le yomarako weŋgi va ŋgora iyake:
Saimon Pita, Tomas (ghaida unouno Gamwaruwo), Nataniyel (rara Kena, Galili e tɨne), Sebedi le ŋgaŋga na gharaghambu theghewova va inanji gheko.
Saimon Pita i dage weŋgiya ghauneko iŋa, “Ghino ya wa va mwaritau.” Thɨŋa, “Weime ghen.” Thɨ rakatha e waŋga na thɨ goraŋgi eto, ko iyemaeŋge gougouko iyako ma thɨ ndewo mun borogi.
Ighɨviya rakaraka Jisas i ndeghathɨ e njighɨko ghadidiye, ko iyemaeŋge gharaghambuko mava thɨ ghareghare, Jisas iya amalaghɨniyeko.
I kula raŋgi weŋgi iŋa, “Wouna, mbe mo hu ndewo muna borogi?” Thɨ gonjoghawe thɨŋa, “Nandere.”
Iŋa, “Hu da lemi ghinana e waŋgana valɨvaŋga e unemina, ambane hu wo borogi seiwo.” Mbaŋa thɨ vakatha ŋgoreiyako, ma valɨkaiwanji thɨ momodɨruwo, kaiwae borogi va lemoyo moli thɨ wona.

Amba gharaghambuma iyava i gharethovuma laghɨye i dage weya Pita iŋa, “Giya iyako!” Mbaŋa Saimon Pita i loŋwe iŋa, “Giya iyako,” i njimbo ghakwama ghayaboyabo na i varuwo e ghavaako e mborowaeko (kaiwae va i mbanɨraŋgiya ghakwama) na i pito e njighɨko tɨne i gaeru.
Vavanako thɨ goreghambawe e waŋgako, thɨ momoda ghinama weiye borogi lemoyo moli. Mava inanji eto, mbwatava lenji didiraŋgi ŋgoreiya handred mitas.
Mbaŋa thɨ goru vanatɨna thɨ thuwe ndɨghe i raŋiŋila, borogi inawe na bred vavana.
Jisas i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Hu bigima borogina vavana iya amba mohu wona.”

Iya kaiwae Saimon Pita i vana e waŋga na i momodɨ ruwo ghinako vanatɨna, borogi laghɨlaghɨye thɨ riyevanjara. Le ghanaghanagha marathaŋarɨ maraelima na mbunɨto (153). Othembe borogiko le ghanaghanagha ŋgoreiyako ghinako mava i ndemoto mun.
Jisas i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Wo hu mena hu ghanɨyanyi.” Gharaghambuŋgiko mava regha ghare i matuwo na i vaito iŋa, “Thela ghen?” kaiwae va thɨ ghareghare Giya mbema amalaghɨniye iyako.
Jisas i mena, i wo bredɨma na i wogiya weŋgi. I vakatha borogima tembe ŋgoreiyeva.
Iyake Jisas va le yomara mbaŋatoniye weŋgiya gharaghambu mbaŋa va i mare na le thuweiru e ghereiye.
Jisas i vaŋgunjogha Pita

Mbaŋa thɨ ghanɨvao, Jisas i vaito Saimon Pita iŋa, “Saimon, Jon nariye, mbema emunjoru u gharethovuŋgo na i kivwalaŋgiya thiyake?” Pita i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Ŋgoreiye Giyana, kaero u ghareghare ya gharethovuŋge.” Jisas i dagewe iŋa, “U vaghanɨŋgiya lo lem.”

Jisas mbowo i vaitova iŋa, “Saimon, Jon nariye, mbema emunjoru u gharethovuŋgo?” I gonjoghawe iŋa, “Ŋgoreiye Giyana, kaero u ghareghare ya gharethovuŋge.” Jisas i dagewe iŋa, “U njimbukikiŋgiya lo sip.”

Jisas i vaito mbaŋatoniye iŋa, “Saimon, Jon nariye, mbe u gharethovuŋgo?” Pita ghare i vɨrɨ kaiwae Jisas mbowo i vaitova mbaŋatoninji, “Mbe u gharethovuŋgo?” I dagewe iŋa, “Giyana, u ghareghare bigibigike wolaghɨye, u ghareghare ya gharethovuŋge.” Jisas i dagewe iŋa, “U vaghanɨŋgiya lo sip.

Ya dage emunjoru e ghen, mbaŋa va tabwagha ghen u ŋgarɨmbiya ghanɨkwama e va, na u wa ŋgoreiya len renuwaŋa, ko mbaŋa ne u thanja, ne u vamomoya nɨmanɨman na lolo regha i ŋgarɨŋgi na ne i vaŋguŋge na u wa ŋgoreiya ma len renuwaŋana nuwaiya u wawe.”
Jisas va i utu ŋgoreiyako na i vamanjamanjalaŋa nevole Pita le mare na Loi ghatarawa i raŋgiwe. Amba i dagewe iŋa, “U ghambuŋgo.”
Pita i ndevɨ na i thuwe Jisas gharaghambuko regha iyava i gharethovuko i rereghamba weŋgi. (Amalaghɨniye iyava i rovadede Jisas mbaŋa va thiya ghanɨŋga na iŋama, “Giyana, thela ne i vatomweŋge?”)
Mbaŋa Pita i thuwe i dage weya Jisas iŋa, “Ŋgoreiye Giyana, ko naka amalake iyake?”
Jisas i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Thoŋgo nuwaŋguiya mbe e yawayawaliye na ghaghada ne ya njoghama, ŋgoroŋgako e ghen? Mbema u ghambuŋgo eŋge.”

Iyake kaiwae utuutuke iyake ma i laloŋgi eŋge raloŋweloŋweghathɨko na thɨŋava iya gharaghambuko iyako mane i mare. Ko Jisas mava iŋa mane i mare, va iŋa, “Thoŋgo nuwaŋguiya mbe e yawayawaliye ghaghada ya njoghama, ŋgoroŋgako e ghen?”
Gharaghambuke iyake iyava i utuŋaŋgiya utuutuke thiyake na i rorinjoŋa. Wo ghareghare budakaiya va i utuŋaŋgi emunjoru.
Jisas vambe i vakathaŋgiva bigibigi lemoyo moli. Thoŋgova thɨ rorivaoŋgiya bigibigiko wolaghɨye, ya renuwaŋa e yambaneke laghɨye bukuŋgike iya thɨ roriŋgike mbala ma e ghambaghambanji.

footnotes.text: Njighɨ Taibiriyas iye Galili Njighɨniye idae regha.
